definitions.explanation: A celebrated, unforgettable scene in a film, drama, sports match, or other performance that audiences remember and replay.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}には{名場面|めいばめん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This movie has many famous scenes.

examples.japanese: あの{試合|しあい}の{逆転|ぎゃくてん}は{名場面|めいばめん}として{語|かた}り{継|つ}がれている。
examples.english: The comeback in that match is passed down as a memorable scene.

examples.japanese: {番組|ばんぐみ}の{最後|さいご}に、ドラマの{名場面|めいばめん}を{集|あつ}めた{特集|とくしゅう}が{放送|ほうそう}された。
examples.english: At the end of the program, a special collecting the drama's famous scenes was broadcast.

notes:
Compound of {名|めい} (famous, excellent) + {場面|ばめん} (scene). The prefix {名|めい} marks something as outstanding, as in {名|めい}{作|さく} (masterpiece) or {名|めい}{言|げん} (famous saying).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名場面|めいばめん}{集|しゅう}: collection of famous scenes
- {数々|かずかず}の{名場面|めいばめん}: numerous memorable scenes
- {名場面|めいばめん}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る: to look back on the highlights

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見|み}せ{場|ば}: highlight; showpiece moment — the part meant to impress, from the performer's side
- ハイライト: highlights — borrowed word, often for sports or recap footage
